title: Acme India Industries IPO Details
intro:
Acme India Industries IPO is a book build issue of ₹121.69 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 54.07 lakh shares aggregating to ₹105.98 crores and offer for sale of 8.02 lakh shares aggregating to ₹15.71 crores.

Acme India Industries IPO opens for subscription on Sep 30, 2026 and closes on Oct 6, 2026. The allotment for the Acme India Industries IPO is expected to be finalized on Oct 7, 2026. Acme India Industries IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Oct 9, 2026.

Acme India Industries IPO is set issue price band at ₹186 to ₹196 per share. The lot size for an application is 600 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,35,200 (1,200 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (1,800 shares), amounting to ₹3,52,800.

Hem Securities Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Bigshare Services Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Hem Finlease Pvt.Ltd.

Refer to Acme India Industries IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in December 2021, Acme India Industries Limited is engaged in the Indian railway rolling stock sector, focusing on the design, manufacture, supply, installation and warranty maintenance of railway coach interiors and components. The Company provides turnkey furnishing solutions for new railway coaches, refurbishment, upgradation and conversion of old coaches, and modernization of toilet facilities. It manufactures and supplies products including Braille signage, FRP products, sanitary ware, epoxy flooring, decorative glass FRP, toilet and compartment doors, seats and berths, fire barrier coatings and hygiene-related products. Since 2017, the Company has completed 28 turnkey furnishing projects covering 1,610 coaches, while it has refurbished and upgraded 1,888 coaches and completed 10,948 toilet upgrades as of June 30, 2026.

The Company operates across 16 railway zones and has three production units and two mid-life rehabilitation units. Its manufacturing facility in Sonipat, Haryana, covers an area of over 92,000 square feet and is equipped with laboratory and testing facilities. The Company also has a design and new product development team involved in product engineering, simulation, prototyping and testing. Its projects are executed across major railway production facilities, including the Modern Coach Factory in Raebareli, Integral Coach Factory in Chennai and Rail Coach Factory in Kapurthala. The Company is ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 15085 certified and is empanelled as a “Business Associate” under a Navratna PSU of the Government of India.

The Company operates primarily through a tender-based business model, with tender-related activities undertaken through the Indian Railways e-Procurement System (IREPS). It has executed projects across multiple coach variants, including LHB coaches, Vande Bharat and other self-propelled units.

As of June 30, 2026, the Company had 43 employees on its payroll across administration, business development, design and new product development, finance, operations, production, project management, supply chain and other functions.
strengths: Healthy order book supporting business visibility.
Experienced Promoters and strong management team with domain knowledge.
Established market presence in the Indian railway sector with a diversified range of products and services under one roof.
Fully integrated manufacturing facility at a strategically favourable location, equipped with machinery and equipment from reputed domestic and global players.

faqs.question: How to apply in Acme India Industries IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Acme India Industries IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Acme India Industries IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Acme India Industries IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Acme India Industries IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of Acme India Industries IPO?
faqs.answer: Acme India Industries IPO lot size is 600 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹2,35,200 , with 2 lots being the minimum application size .

faqs.question: How to apply for Acme India Industries IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Acme India Industries IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Acme India Industries IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Acme India Industries IPO will be done on Wednesday, October 7, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Thu, Oct 8, 2026 . Check the Acme India Industries IPO allotment status .

faqs.answer: The Acme India Industries IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Fri, Oct 9, 2026 .
